Solder bridging Open circuit
Rule → Mechanism → Solder bridging 7 rules · last edited 15 Oct 2026 by Priya S.

Aperture overfill

4 rules
Low aperture area ratio or high stencil thickness
Seen 3×
ApertureAreaRatio < LSL OR StencilThickness > USL
Spec ≥ 0.66 · 95–105 µm Stencil · Setting
Corrective action: Use a thinner foil or step-down stencil; redesign apertures below the area ratio limit.
Low squeegee angle with low speed or high pressure
Seen 2×
SqueegeeAngle < LSL AND (SqueegeeSpeed < LSL OR SqueegeePressure > USL)
Spec 55–65° · 56–84 mm/s · 0.27–0.33 MPa Solder printer · Setting
Corrective action: Replace the squeegee blade; check angle, speed and pressure against the recipe.
Low squeegee speed
Seen 2×
SqueegeeSpeed < LSL
Spec 56–84 mm/s Solder printer · Setting
Corrective action: Raise the speed to nominal (70 mm/s).
High bead size of solder paste
Seen 1×
PasteBeadSize > USL
Spec 3.6–4.4 mm³ Solder printer · Setting
Corrective action: Reduce bead width and mass.
Supported by measurement Paste volume per aperture above USL · SPI · spec 0.036–0.044 mm³

Excess reflow spreading

2 rules
High peak reflow temperature
Seen 5×
PeakReflowTemperature > USL
Spec 245–255 °C Reflow oven · Setting
Corrective action: Restore the approved reflow recipe; lock recipe changes behind sign-off.
High ambient temperature
Not seen yet
AmbientTemperature > USL
Spec [your limit] Line · Environment
Corrective action: Check HVAC on the line.

Post-print spread

1 rule
High ambient RH
Seen 1×
AmbientRh > USL
Spec [your limit] Line · Environment
Corrective action: Control humidity; check paste exposure time.
